name: Startup Crew
tagline: Describe the app. The crew builds the smallest thing that runs.
blurb: A lead who picks the stack, writes the scaffold and names the API shapes, and members who build behind those seams. Talk to it about what you want; when it is clear enough, it opens a session and the crew ships something you can start.
capabilities: The lead assembles and runs it

bot.helpsWith: Builds a working app with a crew, scaffold, features, and how to run it.
